name: Vijay Dark Admin Mode
author: Vijay solanki

sections.description:
Admin Dark Mode adds Light, Dark, and System theme options to the WordPress admin dashboard.

The plugin provides a floating switcher that lets each logged-in user choose their preferred admin color mode. The System option follows the operating system’s color-scheme preference.

Key Features:

  • 3-Way Theme Switcher: Choose between System, Light, and Dark modes.
  • System (Auto) Mode: Automatically syncs with your Operating System theme in real-time.
  • Draggable Widget: The floating widget can be dragged to any position on the screen, and the position is saved automatically.
  • Per-User Preference: Each logged-in WordPress user can save their own individual color mode preference.
  • Unobtrusive: The draggable widget can be moved so it doesn’t block other interface elements like the Gutenberg Block Editor or Elementor panels.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin package to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Go to the “Plugins” menu in WordPress and activate the plugin.
  3. You will see a floating widget at the bottom right of your screen.
  4. Drag it to your preferred position and click the icons to switch themes.
sections.faq:
Where is the Dark Mode button located?

By default, a floating widget will appear at the bottom-right corner of your screen. You can click the drag handle on the left of the widget to move it.

Does it sync with my computer’s theme?

Yes! By default, the widget is set to “System” (the Desktop icon). This means if your Windows/Mac is in Dark Mode, WordPress will automatically switch to Dark Mode. If you change your OS theme, WordPress updates in real-time without needing a page reload.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Complete UI Overhaul: Replaced standard top-bar switch with an interactive, animated, floating widget.
  • Added 3-Way Mode (System Auto, Light, Dark).
  • Added real-time OS Theme syncing.
  • Added Drag & Drop functionality to move the widget anywhere on the screen.
  • Fixed WordPress Plugin Check (PCP) errors and optimized code.

1.0

  • Initial Release.
